versions.label: Throttled watch-panel updates
changes: Kept the responsive embed mode so the full playfield still fits cleanly in the compare app.
Reduced perceived jerkiness by throttling expensive stats-panel rewrites during watch mode instead of doing a full DOM rewrite every frame.
Archived v1.5.0 under versions/1.5.0/pong_evolution.html after the earlier delta-time and responsive layout update.

versions.label: Responsive embed mode + smoother watch loop
changes: Made the layout and canvases more responsive so the full playfield fits better in narrow or embedded layouts.
Added an embed mode used by the compare app to reduce spacing while keeping the full control set available.
Smoothed watch mode with delta-time stepping and capped background training work per frame; archived v1.4.1 under versions/1.4.1/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: Generation explanation + archive refresh
changes: Explained what a generation means in the UI and learning log.
Clarified the evaluate -> select elites -> mutate loop in the stats panel.
Archived v1.4.0 under versions/1.4.0/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: HiDPI charts + axis + live evolution controls
changes: Added high-DPI chart rendering and generation axis labels.
Added continuous watch with optional auto-train and step-generation controls.
Moved stats panel to right pane and moved legend outside gameplay canvas.

versions.label: Clearer training metrics + manual stop + color cues
changes: Improved training chart to plot both best and average fitness per generation.
Added explicit Stop animation button and stronger stop conditions for watch mode.
Color-coded scripted opponent vs AI paddle and clarified score labels/definitions.

versions.label: Training chart + playback speed controls
changes: Added live training chart to visualize best fitness over generations.
Added speed slider affecting training pacing and watch playback speed.
Archived v1.2.2 under versions/1.2.2/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: UI startup hardening + safer changelog rendering
changes: Added global error hooks to surface startup/runtime failures in-page.
Refactored changelog rendering into a shared helper and guarded modal element wiring.
Archived v1.2.1 under versions/1.2.1/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: Startup reliability + history fallback
changes: Added defensive startup checks so runtime errors are surfaced in-page.
Added changelog fallback data so version history still works when JSON fetch fails.
Archived the previous current build as versions/1.2.0/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: Fixed GitHub Pages base-path version loading
changes: Fixed root URL detection so changelog/version switching works on project pages (e.g. /ML/...).
Ensured current-file detection resolves correctly when loaded from root or /versions/... paths.
Archived the previous current build as versions/1.1.0/pong_evolution.html.

versions.label: Version archive support + changelog modal
changes: Added version footer + changelog modal.
Added root-aware version switching for current and archived paths.
Fetches pong_evolution.versions.json with cache-busting to avoid stale history.

versions.label: Initial Pong Evolution release
changes: Initial plain JavaScript Pong Evolution implementation.
Neuroevolution loop with mutation, selection, and best-bot watch mode.
